fact: Orange Burkina Faso's 2017-2024 CSR report says the company invested about 257 billion FCFA since 2017, building more than 1,300 sites, with 364 rural sites by 2024 (the company investing its own money, cumulative, not split by year).
title: Orange Burkina Faso : 257 milliards F CFA d'investissements pour l'inclusion numérique des populations
